route_policy.body: xhs --cookie-source chrome read NOTE_ID --json (prefer the bare note id from search; the CLI reuses its cached note token and xsec_source. If a URL is required, use the note-level xsec_token, never the author token note_card.user.xsec_token)
route_policy.cookie_cache: The CLI prefers its saved cookie cache (~/.xiaohongshu-cli/cookies.json) and re-reads the browser only when that cache is older than 7 days or a session-expired error forces one refresh, so --cookie-source chrome does not re-read Chrome on every call. Refresh deliberately with: xhs login --cookie-source chrome (extracts the already-logged-in browser session; no QR, no new login).

error_classification.http_461_471: verification_required - the platform asks for human verification: complete it in the browser, refresh the cookie cache, then retry slowly. Repeated retries escalate the block instead of clearing it.
error_classification.code_-100: not_authenticated - the server-side session is dead: the user logs in again in the browser, then refresh the cookie cache.
error_classification.code_300015: signature_error - report it; do not loop the same request shape.
error_classification.empty_noteDetailMap: api_error, and NOT proof the note is missing: the CLI falls back to an HTML read and can mask an earlier verification failure. Re-run the classification before reporting the note as absent.

forbidden: automatic generic browser or MCP substitution
route_policy.on_failure: Classify the failure first (see error_classification) before retrying. On verification_required: stop the request chain, have the user complete the check in the browser, refresh the cookie cache with xhs login --cookie-source chrome, then resume with slower pacing. Diagnose and retry the same dedicated route on the approved host when appropriate; otherwise report the exact blocker. Never unlock OpenCLI. Allowed indexed-web discovery is indirect.
route_policy.comment_signer: The dedicated xhs-comments helper uses an internal browser-native signer, not OpenCLI; top-level comments only.

search_route_policy.on_failure: Preserve API status and rerun the same API command on the approved host when appropriate; otherwise report the blocker. No automatic fallback.
search_route_policy.separate_readers: OpenCLI answer-detail and answer-comments remain separate body/comment readers; they do not authorize OpenCLI keyword search.
